long_description:
Discover the true meaning of Diwali. Learn Science of Spirituality meditation to connect with inner light and peace. 

While Diwali is universally celebrated with clay lamps, fireworks, and festivities, the mystics and saints throughout the ages have pointed toward a deeper, eternal celebration: lighting the lamp within. SOS meditation awakens the radiant spiritual light within our spiritual eye, removing the darkness of ignorance, stress, and discord.

Join us at the National India Hub in Schaumburg for an uplifting morning designed to help you tap into lasting inner peace, clarity, and unconditional joy.

Complimentary special spiced tea & light vegetarian refreshments served

All are welcome. The program is free of charge.
